title: REQ · Approve, Retry and Reject 401 clear the token and show the gate with no stale action error
summary: Each execution action's 401 reaches handleError, which clears the token and the action error state.
description: runExecutionAction already delegates a 401 to handleError. handleError must also clear actionError and actionDetail so no earlier action failure survives the return to the gate.
acceptance_criteria: Given approve, retry or reject returns 401, when the response arrives, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'.
Given actionError was set by a prior 500, when a 401 follows, then actionError and actionDetail are cleared.
definition_of_done: 401 branch clears token, actionError and actionDetail
